response.sql: SELECT AVG(media_avg) FROM (SELECT mt.Name, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS media_avg FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes <= 10323804 GROUP BY mt.Name) AS per_media_type;

assumptions.assumption: The file-size cutoff is a maximum, so tracks of 10,323,804 bytes or less pass.
Tracks with zero milliseconds cannot contribute a bytes-per-millisecond value; NULLIF excludes them from the average.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff is a minimum file size, so tracks of 10,323,804 bytes or more pass.
